blocks.text: Home safety evaluations for senior care are essential processes to ensure the well-being and safety of older adults who may require assistance or support in their daily lives. These evaluations aim to assess the physical, mental, and environmental factors that contribute to the overall quality of life for seniors. They help identify potential risks, recommend necessary interventions, and create a comprehensive care plan tailored to the individuals needs.

This process can be stressful and emotional, let our hands of the heart help make this transitional life change easier with our care and expertise. Health Care Professionals with each placement. You keep your independence even if you need a little support. We are proud to partner with professionals to assist with daily living activities. Let our hands of the heart help you find the best match for placement when home is not an option any longer.

Rachal Payne, a seasoned Registered Nurse, brings over 25 years of experience dedicated to improving the lives of those in need. With a strong background in patient care, coordination of services, and advocacy,Rachal is also a Survivor of Suicide. Her personal losses have fueled her commitment to supporting individuals suffering from similar burdens and providing heartfelt support.

Your hospice team is specially trained in endof- life care, which can be provided anywhere the patient calls home, whether that’s assisted living, a nursing home, or a private residence. Hospice care can also be provided in hospitals and facilities that cater exclusively to hospice patients.
Our team can help you have an understanding of your Long-Term Insurance Policy.

Do you want to help understand what your loved one is experiencing with memory loss and to teach how to be grateful for today and past memories? We have expertise in different types and stages of Alzheimer’s and Dementia. Alzheimer’s affects certain parts of the brain that we can help educate the right treatment and daily care needs.

Connect with others who have lost a loved one to suicide, hear how they have directed their loss, and learn how to support loss survivors. The loss of a loved one by suicide is shocking, painful, unexpected, and this leaves you empty with a heightened sense of guilt and unknown feelings. The things you wonder about being “normal”? The grief that capsulates you can be intense, complex and long term. Grief and bereavement are an extremely individual and unique process. Survivors of suicide are not looking for their lives to return to their prior state. Survivors aim to adjust to life without their loved one.
